caption: The video captures a man in a black tank top, black shorts, white crew socks and dark shoes standing in right-facing profile on checkered gym mats, holding the handles of a jump rope. A bright window with reversed lettering, boxing gloves on the sill, a teal exercise ball, a wall-mounted bar, a circular plaque and a 'CHAMPIONS' sign fill the background. For the first portion he stands nearly upright with his head lowered, the rope hanging loose and a loop resting on the floor. He makes small foot lifts and adjustments while gripping the handles. His arms then move outward as the rope arcs up and around his body into a motion-blurred streak. He settles into a continuous jumping rhythm, repeatedly leaving the ground. The blurred rope passes beneath his feet and around his body as the camera stays fixed on the unmoving background. The clip holds him on the ground rather than airborne.
relations: The man's arms swinging outward causes the loose jump rope to arc upward and around his body.
The rope sweeping beneath his feet corresponds with his rhythmic lifting off the checkered gym mats.
The stationary camera keeps the window, boxing gloves, and exercise ball fixed in the background.
